_note: Machine-readable index of every published card errata in this directory. NEW TEXT only; it overrides the printed card and the official gallery. Sources: 'Riftbound Card Errata 10-21-2025 .pdf', 'UPDATED Riftbound Errata File 1-12-26.pdf', unleased.txt, vendetta-errata.txt, radiance-errata.txt.

Ava Achiever.text: When I attack, you may pay [C] to play a card with [Hidden] from your hand, ignoring its cost. If it's a unit, play it here.

Baited Hook.text: [1][C], [E]: Kill a friendly unit. Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may banish a unit from among them that has Might up to 1 more than the killed unit and play it, ignoring its cost. Then recycle the rest.

Blind Fury.text: [Action] Each opponent reveals the top card of their Main Deck. Choose one and banish it, then play it, ignoring its cost. Then recycle the rest.

Clockwork Keeper.text: You may pay [C] as an additional cost to play me. When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, draw 1.

Convergent Mutation.text: [Reaction] Choose a friendly unit. This turn, increase its Might to the Might of another friendly unit.

Dark Child, Starter.text: At the end of your turn, ready up to 2 runes.

Dazzling Aurora.text: At the end of your turn, reveal cards from the top of your Main Deck until you reveal a unit and banish it. Play it, ignoring its cost, and recycle the rest.

Disintegrate.text: [Action] Deal 3 to a unit at a battlefield. If this kills it, do this: draw 1.

Dragon's Rage.text: Move an enemy unit. Then do this: Choose another enemy unit at its destination. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.

Dune Drake.text: When I attack, give me +2 [M] this turn if there is a ready enemy unit here.

Highlander.text: [Reaction] Choose a friendly unit. The next time it would die this turn, heal it, exhaust it, and recall it instead.

Karma, Channeler.text: [Vision] When you recycle one or more cards to your Main Deck, buff a friendly unit.

Kinkou Monk.text: When you play me, buff up to two other friendly units.

Nocturne, Horrifying.text: [Ganking] As you look at or reveal me from the top of your deck, you may banish me. If you do, you may play me for [A].

Pack of Wonders.text: [E]: Return another friendly gear, unit, or facedown card to its owner's hand.

Portal Rescue.text: [Action] Banish a friendly unit, then its owner plays it to their base, ignoring its cost.

Promising Future.text: Each player looks at the top 5 cards of their Main Deck, banishes one of them, then recycles the rest. Starting with the next player, each player plays those cards, ignoring Energy costs. (They must still pay Power costs.)

Ravenborn Tome.text: [E]: The next spell you play this turn deals 1 Bonus Damage.

Salvage.text: [Action] You may kill up to one gear. Draw 1.

Sigil of the Storm.text: When you conquer here, you must recycle one of your runes. (This doesn't choose anything.)

Sona, Harmonious.text: At the end of your turn, if I'm at a battlefield, ready up to 4 friendly runes.

Targon's Peak.text: When you conquer here, ready up to 2 runes at the end of this turn.

Teemo, Strategist.text: [Hidden] When I defend, choose an enemy unit here and reveal the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. Deal 1 to that unit for each card with [Hidden] revealed this way, then recycle the revealed cards.

The Boss.text: If a buffed unit you control would die, you may pay [C], exhaust me, and spend its buff to heal it, exhaust it, and recall it instead. When you conquer, ready me.

The Dreaming Tree.text: When a player chooses a friendly unit here with a spell for the first time each turn, they draw 1.

The Syren.text: [1], [E]: Move a friendly unit at a battlefield to its base.

Tideturner.text: [Hidden] When you play me, you may choose a unit you control at another location. Move me to its location and it to my original location.

Unforgiven.text: [2], [E]: Move a friendly unit to or from its base.

Unlicensed Armory.text: Discard 1, [E]: Choose a friendly unit. The next time it would die this turn, you may pay [C] to heal it, exhaust it, and recall it instead.

Void Gate.text: Spells and abilities deal 1 Bonus Damage to units here.

Zhonya's Hourglass.text: [Hidden] If a friendly unit would die, kill this instead. Heal that unit, exhaust it, and recall it.

Falling Star.text: Deal 3 to a unit. Deal 3 to a unit.

Icathian Rain.text: Deal 2 to a unit. Deal 2 to a unit. Deal 2 to a unit. Deal 2 to a unit. Deal 2 to a unit. Deal 2 to a unit.

Reinforce.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may banish a unit from among them, then play it, reducing its cost by [5]. Recycle the remaining cards.

Arise!.text: Play a 2 [M] Sand Soldier unit token for each Equipment you control. Then do this: Ready up to two of them.

Deathgrip.text: [Reaction] Kill a friendly unit. If you do, give +[M] equal to its Might to another friendly unit this turn. Draw 1.

Edge of Night.text: [Hidden] When you play this from face down, attach it to a unit you control (here). [Equip] [C]

Janna, Savior.text: [Reaction] When you play me, heal your units here, then move up to one enemy unit from here to its base.

Jax, Unmatched.text: [Deflect] Your Equipment everywhere have [Quick-Draw]. (Each gains [Reaction]. When you play it, attach it to a unit you control.)

Kato the Arm.text: [Deflect] When I move to a battlefield, give another friendly unit my keywords and +[M] equal to my Might this turn.

Rek'Sai, Swarm Queen.text: When I attack, you may reveal the top 2 cards of your Main Deck. You may banish one, then play it. If it is a unit, you may play it here. Recycle the rest.

Rell, Magnetic.text: [Tank] When I attack, you may play an Equipment with Energy cost no more than [2], ignoring its cost. If you do, then do this: Attach it to me.

Tianna Crownguard.text: [Deflect] While I'm at a battlefield, opponents can't gain points.

Void Burrower.text: When you conquer, you may exhaust me to reveal the top 2 cards of your Main Deck. You may banish one, then play it. Recycle the rest.

Void Rush.text: Reveal the top 2 cards of your Main Deck. You may banish one, then play it, reducing its cost by [2]. Draw any you didn't banish.

Yone, Blademaster.text: [Weaponmaster] When I conquer a battlefield that was uncontrolled, deal damage equal to my Might to an enemy unit in a base.

Draven, Vanquisher.text: When I win a combat, play a Gold gear token exhausted. When I attack or defend, you may pay [C] to give me +2 [M] this turn.

Emperor's Dais.text: When you conquer here, you may pay [1] and return a unit you control here to its owner's hand to play a 2 [M] Sand Soldier unit token here.

Fizz, Trickster.text: When you play me, you may play a spell from your trash with Energy cost no more than [3], ignoring its Energy cost. Then recycle it. (You must still pay its Power cost.)

Diana, Lunari.text: When a showdown begins here, you may pay [1] to [Predict], then reveal the top card of your Main Deck. If it's a spell, draw it.

Stalking Wolf.text: [Ambush] As an additional cost to play me, kill a Bird, Cat, Dog, or Poro you control. You may [Ambush] me to its battlefield, even if you don't have other units there.

Astral Heron.text: When you play your first card each turn, if I'm at a battlefield, the next card you play this turn costs [2][A][A] less.

Gangplank, Naval.text: [Empower] [C][C] [Empowered][>] If a spell or ability that chooses me would stun me, give me -[M], or return me to hand, give me +3 [M] this turn instead.

Resonating Strike.text: [Hidden] [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Choose a battlefield you control and a unit you control at a different location. Move that unit to that battlefield and give it +2 [S] this turn.

Guards!.text: [Hidden] Play a 2 [M] Sand Soldier unit token. Then do this: You may pay [C] to ready it.

Relentless Pursuit.text: [Action] Move a friendly unit. You may attach up to one Equipment with the same controller to it. This turn, that unit has "When I conquer, you may move me to my base."

Death from Below.text: Kill a unit at a battlefield. Then, if it had 3 [M] or less, do this: You may play this from your trash for [A].

Bone Skewer.text: [Hidden] Choose a battlefield. An opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a unit from it. They play that unit to that battlefield, ignoring any and all costs. If they do, then do this: [Stun] it.

Deceiver.text: When you conquer or hold, you may discard 1 and exhaust me to play a ready Reflection unit token there. Then do this: It becomes a copy of another unit there. Give it [Temporary].

Mirror Image.text: Choose a unit. Play a ready Reflection unit token to your base. Then do this: It becomes a copy of that unit. Give it [Temporary].

Keeper of Masks.text: [Hidden] [Temporary] When you play me, play two Reflection unit tokens here. Then do this: They become copies of me.

Rengar, Trophy Hunter.text: [Ambush] I can [Ambush] to a battlefield where there are enemy units, even if you don't have units there.

Elnuk Herd.text: [Hidden] When you play me, give a friendly unit +3 [M] this turn, then recycle me if I was played from face down.

Last Caress.text: [Reaction] The next unit you play this turn, even from face down, can be played to any battlefield. When you play it, [Buff] it.

Forbidden Technique.text: Ready a unit. When you play a card with Energy cost [7] or more, you may play this from your trash for [1][C][C]. Then banish this.

Neeko, Blending In.text: If Neeko is in your deck, choose up to 3 different legends in addition to your starting legend. When you play me, choose one of those Legends and add it to your Legend Zone while I'm on the board.
